props.title: Building the place where ==anyone== builds
props.subtitle: Q3 check-in: where we are, what shipped, and what we're aiming at next.

slides.notes: Welcome everyone, thank remote folks for joining. One line on why this quarter mattered before diving in.
Keep this fast. Remind people to drop questions in the thread for the Q&A block.

props.label: Why we're here
props.text: Software used to belong to the people who could write it. Bolt exists so an ==idea== is enough — you describe it, and a real, working app appears in your browser. Every quarter we get closer to that being true for everyone.

slides.notes: Slow down here. This is the grounding beat before the numbers — connect it to a real user story from this quarter.

props.kicker: Apps created on Bolt, all time
props.caption: Up ==42%== quarter over quarter — most of it from people who had never built software before.

slides.notes: Pause and let the count-up land. Call out that non-developer share of creators keeps climbing.

items.title: Reliability
items.body: Prompt-to-deploy success from 81% to 90%. Boring, compounding, everything depends on it.

items.title: Enterprise
items.body: SSO, audit logs and procurement-ready security so teams can standardize on Bolt.

items.title: The agent
items.body: Longer horizons: multi-step plans, background work, and builds that finish while you sleep.

slides.notes: These are THE three. If a project doesn't ladder into one of them, we should be asking why we're doing it.
